verdict.rationale: Expensify documents two recurring automations of its own: reports are submitted automatically "based on your timeline", and a daily sync with QuickBooks Online runs on a fixed schedule. These are narrow, built-in schedules for specific expense functions, not a general way to schedule arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: user-defined scheduling of arbitrary jobs or workflows, configurable recurrence (cron or intervals) beyond report submission, API- or agent-driven schedule management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Automatically submits reports based on your timeline
Daily sync updates your chart of accounts, customers/projects, and bank accounts.
